svg.text: Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• The browser checks the invite form first (required fields, email format, password at least 8 characters) and
shows its own message; the API checks the same rules again.
• No email is sent when an account is created; the Admin gives the temporary password to the person.
• Pressing Cancel in the confirmation popup changes nothing. Only an Admin can open this page or call these API
